name: drip
description: Give Claude drip: a real designer's process for coding agents. Run /drip:design and Claude studies Dribbble references, builds a moodboard for you to pick a direction from, writes a design system, builds with real components and fit-checks its own work on screenshots. Opt-in: it only steps in when you start it.

interface.shortDescription: A real designer's process: references, moodboards, design systems, fit checks.
